dialogues.speaker: "Epic Feast Showdown" Promotional Board
dialogues.text: "A banquet becomes a battlefield! Appetites square off in the 'Epic Feast Showdown'! Now in full swing!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Next to this passionate slogan is a portrait of Varesa, who seems to be the spokesperson for this event. There's even a list of her victories...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...It seems that she emerges as champion whenever she enters the competition. Is that why so many challengers come here after hearing the news?)
